newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU ministers seek talks on debt conversion to euro.
newsitem.headline: EU ministers seek talks on debt conversion to euro.

text.p: European Union finance ministers called on Monday for technical talks to iron out legal issues involving conversion of member countries' debt into Euros before an EU summit in Dublin, a Commission source said on Monday.

Under a compromise ageed at an EU summit in Madrid last year, countries will be obliged to issue all new debt in euros from 1999, but it will be up to individual countries to decide whether to convert their stock of debt into euros straight away.
Ministers discussed a legal text underpinning this and other agreements at a meeting here on Monday.
Germany, which has not yet decided when to convert its stock of debt, was concerned about how other countries would treat borrowings in marks issued outside Germany.
"The ministers agreed there should be technical discussions between now and Dublin to deal with this point," the Commission source said.
EU leaders will hold a summit meeting in Dublin on December 13-14.
